title: The Evil Temple and the Moving Rocks
titleZh: 邪恶神殿与移动的岩石
statementMd:
Important: All possible tests are in the pretest, so you shouldn't hack on this problem. So, if you passed pretests, you will also pass the system test.

You are an adventurer currently journeying inside an evil temple. After defeating a couple of weak monsters, you arrived at a square room consisting of tiles forming an $*n* × *n*$ grid, surrounded entirely by walls. At the end of the room lies a door locked with evil magical forces. The following inscriptions are written on the door:

The sound of clashing rocks will awaken the door!

Being a very senior adventurer, you immediately realize what this means. In the room next door lies an infinite number of magical rocks. There are four types of rocks:

- '`^`': this rock moves upwards;
- '`<`': this rock moves leftwards;
- '`>`': this rock moves rightwards;
- '`v`': this rock moves downwards.

To open the door, you first need to place the rocks on some of the tiles (one tile can be occupied by at most one rock). Then, you select a single rock that you have placed and activate it. The activated rock will then move in its direction until it hits another rock or hits the walls of the room (the rock will not move if something already blocks it in its chosen direction). The rock then deactivates. If it hits the walls, or if there have been already $10^{7}$ events of rock becoming activated, the movements end. Otherwise, the rock that was hit becomes activated and this procedure is repeated.

If a rock moves at least one cell before hitting either the wall or another rock, the hit produces a sound. The door will open once the number of produced sounds is at least $*x*$. It is okay for the rocks to continue moving after producing $*x*$ sounds.

The following picture illustrates the four possible scenarios of moving rocks.

- Moves at least one cell, then hits another rock. A sound is produced, the hit rock becomes activated. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8cbe9b01622690f239a41895082961e3232f23e6.png)
- Moves at least one cell, then hits the wall (i.e., the side of the room). A sound is produced, the movements end. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e34e4e413fddf41632ebf903dc704f0568a7fa8c.png)
- Does not move because a rock is already standing in the path. The blocking rock becomes activated, but no sounds are produced. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7672c0f36899e27abe730662cdad3ff8014e12b4.png)
- Does not move because the wall is in the way. No sounds are produced and the movements end. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f188ef504d002fb921e37507b32ed25d39bd4112.png)

Assume there's an infinite number of rocks of each type in the neighboring room. You know what to do: place the rocks and open the door!

## Input

The first line will consists of two integers $*n*$ and $*x*$, denoting the size of the room and the number of sounds required to open the door. There will be exactly three test cases for this problem:

- $*n* = 5, *x* = 5$;
- $*n* = 3, *x* = 2$;
- $*n* = 100, *x* = 10^{5}$.

All of these testcases are in pretest.

## Output

Output $*n*$ lines. Each line consists of $*n*$ characters — the $*j*$-th character of the $*i*$-th line represents the content of the tile at the $*i*$-th row and the $*j*$-th column, and should be one of these:

- '`^`', '`<`', '`>`', or '`v`': a rock as described in the problem statement.
- '`.`': an empty tile.

Then, output two integers $*r*$ and $*c*$ ($1 ≤ *r*, *c* ≤ *n*$) on the next line — this means that the rock you activate first is located at the $*r*$-th row from above and $*c*$-th column from the left. There must be a rock in this cell.

If there are multiple solutions, you may output any of them.

## Note

Here's a simulation of the first example, accompanied with the number of sounds produced so far.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8da2a0ae6b49ed81c14f289f492564607922631.png) 0 sound

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be84b40433e444ca47880780383e6acf5f424553.png) 1 sound

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/10efd16f63914340bbcd47fd4dae573abebf7349.png) 2 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6124aca31c4ed52cf3a82f76fd7666dd3faeb062.png) 3 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a965dca794fb4526eb9391da8d9efdf5d2780b36.png) 4 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/109db8b801276216cbf62dc696b5ba8daaee85ae.png) still 4 sounds

In the picture above, the activated rock switches between the '`^`' rock and the '`<`' rock. However, no sound is produced since the '`^`' rock didn't move even a single tile. So, still 4 sound.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/78aced27e10f7c177bd8bd141bb4873ab60258be.png) 5 sounds

At this point, 5 sound are already produced, so this solution is already correct. However, for the sake of example, we will continue simulating what happens.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/60ddc683342fca12653c678a894df2a22c1dd7b6.png) 6 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f9a5cfaaad61e97752c0ae09cc87c1ce29746f2.png) 7 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5079e2b3ccf5240033a06e5184ccd34fa4aabb74.png) still 7 sounds

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95deff21e644d1330804602b488ec8a408a473d5.png) 8 sounds

And the movement stops. In total, it produces 8 sounds. Notice that the last move produced sound.

Here's a simulation of the second example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ad287eaede249415b03f4e23deefb33079fdbd9d.png) 0 sound

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a669e44f87f9bcc55c05a374d9f0b733b97935e.png) 1 sound

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a424eb23fb814c345b790d250ad88998c0f2461e.png) 2 sounds

Now, the activated stone will switch continuously from one to another without producing a sound until it reaches the $10^{7}$ limit, after which the movement will cease.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f4b524bec262e4db57efa6b5d1d9a5ce51a9c5db.png)

In total, it produced exactly 2 sounds, so the solution is correct.
statementZhMd:
重要提示：所有可能的测试数据都已包含在预测试中，因此你不应该在这道题上进行 hack。因此，如果你通过了预测试，也一定能通过系统测试。

你是一名正在邪恶神殿中探险的冒险者。在击败了几个弱小的怪物后，你来到了一个方形房间。房间由瓷砖组成，形成一个 $*n* × *n*$ 的网格，四周完全被墙壁包围。房间尽头有一扇被邪恶魔法锁住的门。门上刻着以下文字：

岩石碰撞的声音将唤醒这扇门！

作为一名经验非常丰富的冒险者，你立刻明白了这句话的含义。隔壁房间里有无限多块魔法岩石。岩石有以下四种类型：

- '`^`'：该岩石向上移动；
- '`<`'：该岩石向左移动；
- '`>`'：该岩石向右移动；
- '`v`'：该岩石向下移动。

为了打开房门，你首先需要将岩石放置在一些瓷砖上（每块瓷砖至多放置一块岩石）。然后，你选择一块已经放置的岩石并将其激活。被激活的岩石会沿其所指方向移动，直到撞到另一块岩石或房间的墙壁（如果其移动方向上已经有物体阻挡，岩石将不会移动）。随后，该岩石停止激活。如果它撞到了墙壁，或者已经发生了 $10^{7}$ 次岩石被激活的事件，移动就会结束。否则，被撞到的岩石将被激活，并重复这一过程。

如果一块岩石在撞到墙壁或另一块岩石之前至少移动了一个格子，那么这次碰撞会产生声音。当产生的声音数量至少为 $*x*$ 时，房门就会打开。产生 $*x*$ 个声音后，岩石继续移动也是允许的。

下图展示了移动岩石时可能出现的四种情况。

- 至少移动一个格子，然后撞到另一块岩石。会产生声音，被撞到的岩石将被激活。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8cbe9b01622690f239a41895082961e3232f23e6.png)
- 至少移动一个格子，然后撞到墙壁（即房间的边缘）。会产生声音，移动结束。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e34e4e413fddf41632ebf903dc704f0568a7fa8c.png)
- 因为路径上已经有一块岩石而无法移动。阻挡的岩石将被激活，但不会产生声音。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7672c0f36899e27abe730662cdad3ff8014e12b4.png)
- 因为前方是墙壁而无法移动。不会产生声音，移动结束。 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f188ef504d002fb921e37507b32ed25d39bd4112.png)

假设隔壁房间里有无限多块每种类型的岩石。你知道该怎么做了：放置岩石并打开房门！

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*x*$，分别表示房间的大小和打开房门所需的声音数量。这道题恰好有三组测试数据：

- $*n* = 5, *x* = 5$；
- $*n* = 3, *x* = 2$；
- $*n* = 100, *x* = 10^{5}$。

所有这些测试数据都包含在预测试中。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 行。每行包含 $*n*$ 个字符——第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 个字符表示第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 列瓷砖的内容，且应为以下字符之一：

- '`^`'、'`<`'、'`>`' 或 '`v`'：题目描述中的岩石；
- '`.`'：空瓷砖。

然后在下一行输出两个整数 $*r*$ 和 $*c*$（$1 ≤ *r*, *c* ≤ *n*$），表示你第一次激活的岩石位于从上往下数第 $*r*$ 行、从左往右数第 $*c*$ 列。该位置必须有一块岩石。

如果有多种方案，你可以输出任意一种。

## 说明

下面是第一个样例的模拟过程，并标出了当前已经产生的声音数量。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8da2a0ae6b49ed81c14f289f492564607922631.png) 0 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be84b40433e444ca47880780383e6acf5f424553.png) 1 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/10efd16f63914340bbcd47fd4dae573abebf7349.png) 2 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6124aca31c4ed52cf3a82f76fd7666dd3faeb062.png) 3 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a965dca794fb4526eb9391da8d9efdf5d2780b36.png) 4 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/109db8b801276216cbf62dc696b5ba8daaee85ae.png) 仍然是 4 个声音

在上图中，被激活的岩石在 '`^`' 岩石和 '`<`' 岩石之间切换。然而，由于 '`^`' 岩石甚至没有移动一个格子，因此不会产生声音。所以仍然是 4 个声音。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/78aced27e10f7c177bd8bd141bb4873ab60258be.png) 5 个声音

此时已经产生了 5 个声音，因此该方案已经正确。不过，为了便于举例，我们将继续模拟之后发生的情况。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/60ddc683342fca12653c678a894df2a22c1dd7b6.png) 6 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3f9a5cfaaad61e97752c0ae09cc87c1ce29746f2.png) 7 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5079e2b3ccf5240033a06e5184ccd34fa4aabb74.png) 仍然是 7 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95deff21e644d1330804602b488ec8a408a473d5.png) 8 个声音

移动停止。总共产生了 8 个声音。注意，最后一次移动产生了声音。

下面是第二个样例的模拟过程：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ad287eaede249415b03f4e23deefb33079fdbd9d.png) 0 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1a669e44f87f9bcc55c05a374d9f0b733b97935e.png) 1 个声音

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a424eb23fb814c345b790d250ad88998c0f2461e.png) 2 个声音

现在，被激活的岩石会在各块岩石之间持续切换而不产生声音，直到达到 $10^{7}$ 的限制，之后移动将停止。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f4b524bec262e4db57efa6b5d1d9a5ce51a9c5db.png)

总共产生了恰好 2 个声音，因此该方案是正确的。
